text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One morning, when I get to my office,
Mejiro
Dober is already there waiting for
me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
N-no I'm not. This is a perfectly normal
time to be
here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the new essential oil I bought was
really
effective, so I slept well!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Actually, aren't you just late? Are you getting enough sleep?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
How are you? Are you getting enough
sleep?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You should at least try to sleep more on
your
days off. Use essential oils to help
you or
something.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That's good... I still worry about you,
though,
since you're always pushing
yourself so hard.
choice_data_list: 気遣ってくれてありがとう

choice_data_list_en: Thanks for looking out for me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm just warning you. I'd be negatively
impacted
too if something happened to
you, so you'd
better watch yourself!

text_block_list.text:
I should be the one saying that. If you'd
like, I can
recommend you some
essential oils.

and get
more rest.
